label: Whatever has received esse is receiving it at every moment at which it is present
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (present-tense reading of reception): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in a principle z (EsseReceivedIn x z, DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN, tenseless) is, at every moment t at which it is present, receiving its esse in z at t (Receipt.ReceivesAt v z x t, the primitive present-tense receipt of definition 506ea036): 'x has esse as received, at each t'. Stated over the primitive, which is open between the senses of disambiguation 71d3bdb7; on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standing composition) it holds by definition, on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 (passion) it is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. It names no giver; with correlativity it gives 40a97664. Entails the onset reading (registered strength order); strictly stronger (Control part 1: receipt at the first moment only). An existential inertialist who accepts correlativity must deny it, by result 7c62adb5 and the rejection of 40a97664; Control part 1 exhibits that position.
